_note: THE ROOMS' STILLS (src/demo/rooms.ts): <CODE>: { <roomSlug>: "<path under demo/, a 4K still>" }. The slugs and their order are data/room-pins.json's (tools/room-pins.py: kitchen, living, bedroom, sleeping, bath, bath1, bath2, balcony, balconies, garden - a studio has kitchen + sleeping, a one-bedroom unit kitchen + living + bedroom). A pin shows on the zoomed model only where its still is listed here; the panel's 'הדמיות' shows exactly these stills, in the room order. Append a unit or a room by adding its key; keys starting with '_' are ignored.
